newsitem.title: THAILAND: Krung Thai Bank cuts deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Krung Thai Bank cuts deposit rates.

text.p: Krung Thai Bank Plc said on Monday it has cut its deposit rates by 25 basis points, effective on Tuesday.
Earlier the bank announced it cut its minimum lending rate by 25 basis points to 12.75 percent, effective on Tuesday.
The bank said its interest rates for three-month deposits will range between 8.75 percent and 9.50 percent, depending on the amount deposited.
Interest rates for six-month and 12-month deposits will range between 8.25 and 9.00 percent, depending on the amount.
Savings account interest rates will remain unchanged at five percent per year, the bank said.
